Mira (Design): Quick check: small UX question for forms — should we show inline errors immediately on blur or wait until submit and use a summary? Also deciding when typed-confirm is appropriate for destructive actions. Jon (Product): Lean hybrid: inline on blur for simple constraints, summary on submit for cross-field/server errors. Tone: "Please fix 2 issues to save" feels clear. Alex (Eng): Implementation note: dedupe identical messages by ID so summary and inline don't repeat. For summary focus use tabindex="-1" + focus(). Example:
Please fix 2 issues to save
. Sam (A11y): Asterisk alone isn't enough. Add aria-required on inputs or include "(required)" in the label. Inline errors: aria-live=polite; summary: aria-live=assertive when shown on submit. Tess (DevEx): For typed-confirm, propose 3 tiers: low = toast undo (10s), medium = checkbox consent, high = typed-confirm. Make typed-confirm case-insensitive by default; allow exact-match flag for critical flows. ci-bot: Note: logging events to add: validation.summary_shown, confirm.typed_attempt. Mira (Design): Good. I'll update the pattern doc and push a tiny Figma. Please comment by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
